stories.title: Pilgrims' Bolero falls into Jhuri river; two dead, four hurt
stories.summary: A Bolero carrying pilgrims from Kanpur to Maihar fell into the Jhuri river on the Madhya Pradesh side of Chitrakoot. Two people died and four were injured.

stories.title: Youth Rohit Patel killed over money dispute in Sangramgarh
stories.summary: A youth, Rohit Patel, was killed over a money dispute in Sangramgarh, Prayagraj.

stories.title: Woman returning from SRN hospital gang-raped in Karchhana; auto driver arrested
stories.summary: A woman returning from SRN hospital was gang-raped in Karchhana, Prayagraj. An auto driver is among those arrested and one more accused has been jailed. Two other accused are being sought.

stories.title: Villagers camping near Lohda beaten and robbed; DIG, SP visit scene
stories.summary: Unknown attackers beat and robbed villagers who were camping near Lohda village in the Pahari area of Chitrakoot. The DIG and SP visited the scene following the robbery.

stories.title: UP STF, Maharashtra police arrest two in Naini for Thane murder of Shiv Sena leader
stories.summary: The UP STF and Maharashtra police arrested two people in Naini, Prayagraj. The arrests are linked to the murder of a Shiv Sena leader in Thane.

stories.title: POCSO gang-rape accused wanted since 2022 caught near Mauaima station
stories.summary: Rahul (25), accused in a POCSO and gang-rape case and wanted since 2022, was caught near Mauaima railway station in Prayagraj.

stories.title: Pickup hits pilgrims walking to Maihar; one dead, two hurt
stories.summary: A pickup vehicle hit pilgrims who were walking to Maihar. One person died and two were injured.

stories.title: Armed gang ties up father and daughter, loots ₹1 lakh
stories.summary: An armed gang of six or more attackers tied up a father and his daughter with a sheet in Chitrakoot. The attackers assaulted them with a sword. The gang looted ₹1 lakh.

stories.title: Student molestation accused arrested after CCTV footage
stories.summary: Police in Prayagraj arrested a man accused of molesting a student. The arrest followed CCTV footage of the incident.

stories.title: Mauaima woman alleges abduction to Nashik, 20 days' captivity and rape
stories.summary: A woman from Mauaima, Prayagraj, alleges that three men abducted her to Nashik. She says the main accused held her captive for 20 days and raped her on the promise of marriage. An FIR has been filed.

stories.title: Biker falls about 20 ft off Jagatpur flyover on Prayagraj–Varanasi highway
stories.summary: A biker fell about 20 feet off the Jagatpur flyover on the Prayagraj–Varanasi highway. The rider is in critical condition.

stories.title: Bharatkup police arrest rape accused Aman Kalar
stories.summary: Bharatkup police have arrested Aman Kalar, accused of rape. A 22-year-old woman had gone with him on September 29. The rape section 64(1) was added to the case after her statement in court.

stories.title: Bike rider injured in hit-and-run in Mau
stories.summary: A youth riding a bike was hit by an unknown vehicle in Mau, Chitrakoot. The injured youth was sent to the district hospital. Mau police are investigating the hit-and-run.

stories.title: Sardhuwa teen accuses man of luring her to Delhi and raping her
stories.summary: A 16-year-old girl in Sardhuwa, Chitrakoot, has accused Indrajeet Nishad (24) of luring her to Delhi with a promise of marriage and raping her. A case has been filed.

stories.title: Two arrested for firing in Bahadurpur, pistol seized
stories.summary: Police arrested two men, Aman Patel and Anil Patel, for a firing incident in Bahadurpur, Karwi. A 315-bore pistol was seized.

stories.title: Woman lured into Manikpur forest and gang-raped; three arrested
stories.summary: A woman was lured into the Manikpur forest by a neighbour and gang-raped by three men. All three accused were later arrested.
